title: undrift configuration
description: Points undrift at a design system's own artifacts. Generated by `undrift init`.

system.description: The design system's package name, e.g. @acme/ds. Used in violation messages and as the default systemImports entry.

tokens.description: Path to a DTCG/JSON token file. Merged with tokensCss; later sources win on collision.

tokensCss.description: Path, or paths, to stylesheets declaring CSS custom properties. Merged in order after `tokens`. light-dark(a, b) values resolve to a.

catalog.description: Path to a CATALOG.md. Richer than componentsFrom (carries for/not-for prose), but treated as possibly incomplete, so no-unknown-components will not fire against it.

componentsFrom.description: Path to the package's .d.ts entry point. Resolved transitively, so compound parts (TableRow, TableCell) are found. Yields a complete catalog, which enables no-unknown-components.

componentsRoot.description: Directory of component source, used by `undrift audit` for docs-coverage.

systemImports.description: Import specifiers treated as the design system. Subpaths match automatically. Defaults to [system].

exemptMarker.description: Comment marker granting a per-line exemption. Must be followed by ': <reason>' — a bare marker does not exempt.

intrinsics.description: Raw HTML elements that have a system equivalent. null means the element is still banned but has no replacement to name.

foreignUi.description: Import prefixes treated as competing UI libraries.

profiles.description: Named file sets and the rules applied to each.

include.description: fast-glob patterns, relative to the config file. Negate with a leading '!'.
